Role Summary
The Web Application Firewall Engineer is responsible for developing, evaluating and managing systems security across the enterprise. This role will work closely with the application development teams to assess applications in development as well as in production. The Web Application Firewall Engineer will help safeguard applications and data from threats and define and drive the implementation of these capabilities.

Primary Responsibilities - How will you help us Grow !

• Partner with application development, infrastructure, cloud, and network teams to understand application behavior, define security requirements, and implement WAF controls with minimal business disruption.

• Assists in the development and implementation of security policies and procedures.

• Instrumental in data security, regulatory compliance, DDoS mitigation, application protection, and threat detection.

• Prepares status reports on security matters to develop security risk analysis scenarios and response procedures.

• Enforces security policies and procedures by administering and monitoring security profiles, reviews security violation reports and investigates possible security exceptions, updates, and maintains and documents security controls.

• Involved in the evaluation of products and/or procedures to enhance productivity and effectiveness.

• Provides direct support to the business and IT staff for systems security related issues.

• Participates in on-call to support WAF operations, respond to security events, troubleshoot urgent production issues, and coordinate timely escalation or remediation as needed.

Education and Experience - What you will bring to the table!

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.

• 7-10 years of experience with WAF technologies and/or networking.

• Hands-on experience administering enterprise WAF platforms such as Akamai, Cloudflare, F5, Imperva, or Azure/AWS WAF.

About the Team

The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT.

Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post-training.

As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real-world usage to better serve users over time.

You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training.

description:

• Du besitzt eine große Passion für moderne Küche, kochst gern und kannst dich mit unseren ikonischen, nachhaltigen und funktionalen Made-in-Germany-Produkten identifizieren.

• Dein Deutsch ist fließend in Wort und Schrift, dein Englisch ist konversationssicher.

• Flexibilität: familientaugliche Arbeitszeiten, Vertrauensarbeitszeit, Homeoffice. Die Stelle kann zu 100 % remote ausgeübt werden, wir wünschen uns regelmäßige persönliche Treffen in Berlin.

• Viele Extras: Deutschlandticket, bezuschusste Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, Corporate Benefits, täglich leckeres Essen im Office und natürlich kulinarische Team-Events.
